name: Western company team
description: A tank platoon with a mechanised platoon cross-attached: the balanced team NATO armies fought in, three squads riding three carriers beside three tanks.

name: Soviet motor rifle company
description: Infantry-heavy: two motor rifle platoons, a squad to each open-topped carrier, with a tank section. The motor rifle division fielded about three tanks to every rifle platoon.

name: Soviet tank company
description: Armour-heavy: four tanks with a motor rifle section riding along. The tank division fielded about twelve tanks to every rifle platoon.

name: Western armored cavalry troop
description: Eyes first: scout cars and light tanks screening, a medium tank and a mechanised section behind them.

name: Covering force
description: Built to trade ground for time: tank destroyers to make an advance pay for every bound, tanks to cover the withdrawal, a squad to hold the ground in between.
